description:
Returns details for one Berlin district (Ortsteil) by ID, optionally with its neighborhoods.

Parameters:
- ortsteil_id (required): 4-digit ID (e.g. "0301")
- planungsraeume: "true" to include all neighborhoods of the district

Key response fields: { ortsteil_id, ortsteil_name, bezirk_id, bezirk_name, planungsraeume?: [...] } (planungsraeume = neighborhoods)
name: berlin_district_details
title: District Details
